config.name: Single pendulum on cart – angle + cart loops
config.description: Angle loop plus a cart-position loop, robust gains from the auto-tuner (recovers from ≈5 N tip pushes). Note the negative-looking behaviour of the cart loop: to return to the centre the cart first moves away (non-minimum-phase).

texts.headline: Recoverable tip push: 0.42 N → 1.23 N (+194 %)
texts.notes: Cancelled – this is the best result found so far. 37 candidates in 1 min 23 s. Applying also sets the push force to 0.61 N for testing.
texts.applied: Robust gains applied: recoverable push 0.42 N → 1.23 N. Restart to try them; Push uses 0.61 N.
texts.cores: Uses 3 CPU cores in parallel (8 available; one stays free for the display).

run_config.name: Single pendulum, base motor – PID
run_config.description: Fixed pivot with a torque motor (reverse-acting PID). Try lowering D to see oscillations, or raising P to see faster, more aggressive recovery.
